name: Sack of Murloc Heads
summary: Along the Hillsbrad beaches, a sack of Murloc Heads is gathered as proof that local shore threats are being culled. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle gives the bundle to passing adventurers for Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Coastal Pests
sections.body: Southshore faces attacks from Syndicate outlaws, Forsaken skirmishers, and wild murlocs along the coast. Officers must show the town's leaders that coastal threats are being culled, so they can secure funding and favor. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle gathers severed heads as proof, though he finds the cargo distasteful. His squeamishness sends the sack with travelers to Marshal Redpath instead of carrying the grisly evidence himself.

faq.q: What is the Sack of Murloc Heads?
faq.answer: The sack holds severed murloc heads gathered from Hillsbrad's western beaches. It gives Southshore's garrison commander physical proof of efforts to pacify the coast.

faq.q: Why won't Lieutenant Farren deliver it himself?
aliases: why farren makes you carry it
faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds carrying a bag of decaying murloc heads revolting. He hands the unpleasant delivery to an obliging adventurer to carry across Southshore.
Marshal Redpath receives the sack. He commands Southshore's defenses, assesses the town's security, and demands proof of defensive efforts.

faq.q: Why does Southshore require murloc heads as proof?
faq.answer: Southshore requires murloc heads as proof because murlocs constantly raid the coast and threaten the harbor. Officers must verify that patrols maintain perimeter security. Tangible trophies help ensure soldiers do not claim credit for idle watches.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you see the frayed logistics and unglamorous daily burdens Southshore's defenders bear as they hold the northern Alliance enclave together.
